messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "giving other people serious infection or getting serious infection from them"
set: ["giving other people serious infection or getting serious infection from them", "avoid being near people who are sick or have an infection", "sharing an injection can pass infection or disease from person to person", "avoid getting up quickly from sitting or lying down", "tell doctor about illness or infection in past few weeks", "stay away from sick people", "avoid getting up too fast from sitting or lying position", "maintenance dose may need to increase during infection", "ensure family or caregiver knows which symptoms may be serious", "call doctor right away if serious side effects occur", "skipping doses can increase risk of infection resistant to medication", "make liquid before taking or giving it", "do not open, crush, or chew them", "not everyone experiences them", "maintenance dose may need to increase during another serious illness", "do not crush, break, chew, or dissolve them"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
